# step parameter

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stepParameter`](gmeow-stepParameter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stepParameter>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

A configurable parameter of a procedure step — a setting, threshold, or variable that governs the step's behaviour without being consumed as input. Range is [owl:Thing.](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing.) Non-functional: a step may have multiple parameters.
